mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT drink_date) FROM coffee_log WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND FORMATDATETIME(drink_date, 'yyyy-MM') = #{yearMonth}) AS coffee_days, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairing WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND FORMATDATETIME(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') = #{yearMonth}) AS pairing_count, (SELECT AVG(pairing_score) FROM pairing WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND FORMATDATETIME(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') = #{yearMonth}) AS avg_pairing_score, (SELECT mood_summary FROM pairing WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND FORMATDATETIME(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_mood_summary

SELECT mood_tags, COUNT(*) AS usage_count FROM pairing WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND FORMATDATETIME(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') = #{yearMonth} AND mood_tags IS NOT NULL AND mood_tags != '' GROUP BY mood_tags ORDER BY usage_count DESC, mood_tags

SELECT roast_level, COUNT(*) AS log_count FROM coffee_log WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND FORMATDATETIME(drink_date, 'yyyy-MM') = #{yearMonth} AND roast_level IS NOT NULL AND roast_level != '' GROUP BY roast_level ORDER BY log_count DESC, roast_level
